label: If c, distinct from x, causes x's being r, then x has r by participation
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise: if c, distinct from x, causes x's being r, then x has r by participation (not through what x is). It is the converse direction of ST I q.44 a.1 ad 1 (STMT-PARTICIPATED-HAS-OTHER-CAUSE: what is by participation is caused by another), generalized from esse to every perfection; the converse is the analyst's.
